description: Manifest for the preenfm3 full-render golden-master fixtures. See tests/golden/README.md and _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/golden-master-test-plan.md. Each entry corresponds to one TEST in tests/golden_master_test.cpp. The full render is byte-stable per (libm-class), NOT per compiler: ubuntu gcc and ubuntu clang both link glibc and produce byte-identical renders, while macOS clang links libsystem and differs. The discriminator is the platform/libm; tests/golden_master_test.cpp selects by __APPLE__. FM feedback amplifies the ~1-ULP libm-driven table differences (Osc::init/Env::init precompute via sinf/expf/logf), so cross-libm renders diverge by >1 audio-LSB within ~1 block. v4: compare tolerance is 256 stored units (= 1 audio-LSB; the firmware clamps to 24-bit then <<8), and the hash is diagnostic-only (goldenCompare is authoritative). Fixture bytes are UNCHANGED from v3. v4-era Phase 3 additions (spec-test-coverage-phase3): 5 nonzero-IM algo goldens + 3 FX goldens; macOS and Linux variants are committed.

comparison.artifactType: int32_t DAC-format render (3 buffers x 64 stereo per block = 192 int32/block); stored value = (24-bit clamped sample) << 8
comparison.authoritativeGate: goldenCompare, ±256 stored int32 units = ±1 audio-LSB (the firmware's final <<8 puts the 24-bit audio in the top 24 bits; a bare ±1 would only cover always-zero padding). Absorbs benign within-platform drift.
comparison.hashRole: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — FNV-1a 64-bit + splitmix64 over a tolerance-1-normalized buffer; a mismatch is printed to stderr but never fails the test (normalization bucket boundaries can flip under benign drift; making it authoritative would defeat the tolerance). goldenCompare is the sole pass/fail gate.
comparison.buildFlag: -ffp-contract=off (tests/CMakeLists.txt) — strict IEEE mul/add, no FMA contraction, for best per-variant reproducibility (does NOT close the cross-libm gap, which is libm-driven)

determinism.scope: per (libm-class): macOS-libsystem and linux-glibc renders differ by >1 LSB within ~1 block (libm-driven table differences amplified by FM feedback); ubuntu gcc and ubuntu clang (both glibc) are byte-identical
determinism.rng: HAL_RNG gated to seed 0 under PFM3_HOST (Synth.cpp:285); downstream noise[] fill loop shared host/firmware
determinism.selfCheck: GoldenMaster.DeterminismSelfCheck renders twice in-process and asserts byte-exact equality (per-variant)

variants.use: CI ubuntu gcc (Host unit tests) + ubuntu clang (Coverage leg)
